 Summary Statement
 Obligation to provide a confidential report has been met and all initial reporting and compliance measures have been taken to comply with the Conflict of Interest Act .
 Assets
 Sole ownership of farm land located in Bowmanville, Ontario
 Gifts
 Gift (Act) Received 2017/05/26 
 Nature
 Flight aboard an Italian military helicopter from Sigonella Air Base to Taormina and return on May 28, 2017
 Source
 Government of Italy
 Circumstances
 Accompanying the Prime Minister in my capacity as Foreign and Defence Policy Advisor
 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as Clerk of the Privy Council and Secretary to the Cabinet, I recused myself on January 21, 2025 from participating in any discussion or decision regarding the re-appointment of Mr. Tobias Nussbaum as Chief Executive Officer of the National Capital Commission in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interest of my friend, Mr. Nussbaum.
 On January 18, 2024, in the exercise of my official duties, I recused myself from any discussion or decision relating to an email received from Microsoft in order to avoid any opportunity to further the private interest of a family friend, Ms. Jean Scott, or provide preferential treatment to Microsoft. 
As part of my conflict of interest screen, I am required to recuse myself if I am made aware of a matter that should have formed part of the screen.
